narr: A cutoff low moved from the Pacific Ocean through the Desert Southwest, triggering a round of thunderstorms. Some storms produced flash flooding and severe winds.
ev: Bogeles Ranch Road was closed from Upper Trout Creek Road to Bogeles Ranch due to flooding.
Pump Station Road and Huffritter Road were closed from Back Road to Highway 93 due to flooding.
Hackberry Road was closed from Highway 93 to Route 66 due to flooding.
Banegas Ranch Road was closed from Banegas Ranch to Highway 93 due to flooding.
Signal Road was closed from Alamo Road to Highway 93 due to flooding.
